text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I think something might be wrong 
with me.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry, it's not a physical 
ailment. It's just... I'm feeling 
incredibly exhilarated.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Competing against such talented people 
made my spirits soar...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I cannot suppress my emotions. ...What 
should I do?
choice_data_list: Maybe you don't have to hold back?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"However, my parents were always calm, 
handling everything without ever getting 
worked up—"
choice_data_list: You are who you are, Flash.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Right now, I find myself wanting 
to surrender to this indescribable 
emotion...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
At the very least, I do not believe that 
to be a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Next is the Tenno Sho (Spring). I look 
forward to seeing who I will be competing 
against.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you laughing by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you caught me watching. I just love 
seeing my juniors having fun, you know?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...On New Year's, you declared that you 
would 'be a wall for your juniors,' didn't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Why did you say something like that?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Walls are meant to be overcome, aren't 
they? Without great obstacles, there can 
be no great growth.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And if you don't grow big and strong, 
"we'll" be in trouble, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, you kind of understand, right? 
Not with your head, but right "here."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In a manner of speaking... yeah. I guess 
it's like a parent's love for their child?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, she ran off, did she? Still, though... 
hehe.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Racing really is so much fun...—
